title: Fuel Rail Pressure Too Low
shortDescription: Fuel rail pressure has dropped below the commanded value.
fullDescription:
Duramax LMM, LML, and L5P engines run common-rail pressures up to 30,000 psi. P0087 sets when actual rail pressure stays at least 15 percent below target.

LML CP4.2 pumps are notorious for catastrophic failures sending metal debris through the entire fuel system; if confirmed, full system replacement is required.

fixSteps.title: Replace fuel filter
fixSteps.instruction: LML/L5P filter replacement and prime via dash button or scan tool.

fixSteps.title: Inspect filter for metal
fixSteps.instruction: Cut open old filter, check for shavings indicating CP4 failure.

fixSteps.title: Run fuel system data log
fixSteps.instruction: Use HP Tuners or Tech 2 to log desired vs actual rail pressure.

fixSteps.title: Replace FCA or pump
fixSteps.instruction: If FCA stuck, replace; if metal in filter, full disaster repair (pump, rails, injectors, lines).

whenToCallPro: CP4 catastrophic failure on LML is a $8000-12000 dealer job.

faq.a: Aftermarket disaster prevention kits filter return fuel and are recommended for LML.

title: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor Performance
shortDescription: VGT position sensor reading does not match commanded vane position.
fullDescription:
Duramax LMM/LML use a Garrett VGT controlled via solenoid duty cycle. P2563 sets when the position sensor disagrees with command for too long.

Typically caused by sooted vanes sticking, failed unison ring, or worn turbo pivot pins.

fixSteps.title: Tech 2 VGT actuator test
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle vanes 0-100 percent, observe smooth motion.

fixSteps.title: Replace VGT solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Bolt-on solenoid mounted on top of turbo. Easy fix if it tests bad.

fixSteps.title: Replace or rebuild turbo
fixSteps.instruction: If solenoid OK and vanes stuck, send turbo for rebuild or replace assembly.

whenToCallPro: Turbo replacement requires manifold disassembly and is dealer-level work.

faq.a: Hard pulls under load can free mildly stuck vanes, worth trying first.

title: SCR NOx Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold
shortDescription: SCR catalyst is not reducing NOx to required level.
fullDescription:
L5P Duramax monitors NOx in/out. P20EE sets when conversion drops below ~70 percent.

Most common cause is a failed outlet NOx sensor. EPA inducement: warning, derate at 200 mi, then 4 mph limp at 0 mi remaining.

fixSteps.title: Replace outlet NOx sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Located on tailpipe after SCR. Use 22 mm socket and anti-seize.

fixSteps.title: Run drive cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Highway drive 30 minutes to allow SCR adaptation.

whenToCallPro: If sensors do not resolve, dealer SCR efficiency test required.

faq.a: Illegal in US/Canada and triggers further faults plus warranty void.

title: Turbo Underboost
fullDescription:
Duramax detects underboost via MAP and MAF cross-check. Common cause is sooted VGT, leaking charge pipes, or sticking wastegate (L5P uses single VGT, no waste).

Results in low power and possible regen failure.

fixSteps.title: Smoke or pressure test charge air
fixSteps.instruction: Find boot cracks, especially driver-side intercooler boot.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed boots/clamps
fixSteps.instruction: Common silicone upgrade replaces stock OEM boots.

fixSteps.title: VGT actuator test
fixSteps.instruction: Tech 2 sweep, look for full vane motion.

whenToCallPro: Turbo replacement requires Y-pipe and cab forward access.

faq.a: Yes, OEM driver-side boot at intercooler outlet often splits past 100k miles.

title: DPF Differential Pressure Sensor Performance
shortDescription: DPF delta-P signal does not match expected pattern.
fullDescription:
DPF differential pressure sensor on Duramax is mounted on the firewall area with two silicone hoses to the DPF. Hoses fill with soot/oil and plug, leading to P2453 or pegged-low readings.

Replace hoses as a wear item every 100k.

fixSteps.title: Remove and clean hoses
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect both ends, clear with compressed air or replace with new silicone.

fixSteps.title: Replace delta-P sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Three-pin sensor on engine bay bracket, swap unit.

whenToCallPro: Only if DPF substrate is suspect.

faq.a: Yes, aftermarket silicone resists plugging far better than OEM.

title: EGR Insufficient Flow
shortDescription: EGR system fails to achieve commanded flow.
fullDescription:
Duramax EGR valves carbon up severely, especially on LBZ/LMM. P0401 indicates the valve cannot move enough soot-laden gas through the cooler.

Clean or replace the EGR valve, and consider professional EGR cooler cleaning.

fixSteps.title: Remove and clean EGR valve
fixSteps.instruction: Carb cleaner and brass brush. Inspect butterfly motion.

fixSteps.title: Inspect EGR cooler ports
fixSteps.instruction: Pull cooler outlet, check for soot brick.

fixSteps.title: Replace EGR valve if needed
fixSteps.instruction: Install new with new gaskets, torque to spec.

whenToCallPro: EGR cooler removal involves coolant work and tight access.

faq.q: How often should I clean it?
faq.a: Every 60-80k miles on diesel-heavy duty cycles.

title: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Not Learned
shortDescription: VGT vane position has not been learned by the ECM.
fullDescription:
After turbo or actuator replacement, the ECM must learn 0 percent and 100 percent vane positions. P003A sets if learn is not completed.

Use Tech 2 or HP Tuners to run the VGT learn procedure.

fixSteps.title: Clear codes and run VGT learn
fixSteps.instruction: Tech 2 service procedure, hot engine, key on.

fixSteps.title: Verify operation
fixSteps.instruction: Test drive, monitor boost vs commanded in scan tool.

whenToCallPro: If you do not have Tech 2 or HP Tuners.

faq.a: No, the procedure must be commanded by the scan tool.

title: Internal Control Module O2/NOx Sensor Performance
fullDescription:
P064D often follows a failed NOx sensor on L5P, but can also indicate ECM internal corruption. Check sensor health first via scan tool live data, then consider ECM update.

Dealer reflash often resolves false sets after sensor replacement.

fixSteps.title: Check NOx sensor live data
fixSteps.instruction: Scan tool, look for plausible NOx ppm and ready status.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed NOx sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Outlet first, then inlet if needed.

fixSteps.title: ECM reflash
fixSteps.instruction: Dealer GDS2 update if codes persist after sensor.

faq.a: It clears, but returns within minutes if sensor or cal is bad.

title: Cooling Fan Relay 1 Control Circuit
shortDescription: Engine cooling fan control circuit fault.
fullDescription:
Duramax uses an electric fan clutch (LMM/LML/L5P). P0480 indicates a fault in the PWM control circuit, often the harness pigtail at the fan clutch failing from heat soak.

Leads to overheating under load and DPF regen issues.
symptoms: Failed regen due to over-temp protection

fixSteps.title: Inspect pigtail at fan clutch
fixSteps.instruction: Look for melted insulation, replace harness pigtail kit.

fixSteps.title: PWM signal test
fixSteps.instruction: Backprobe and verify PCM is sending duty cycle.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan clutch
fixSteps.instruction: 32 mm fan wrench, install new clutch.

whenToCallPro: Only if PCM driver is suspect.

faq.a: It sits inches from exhaust manifold and bakes over time.

title: Barometric Pressure Sensor Performance
fullDescription:
L5P uses a separate BARO sensor in the engine bay. P2227 sets when the value disagrees with MAP at key-on or steady state.

Corrupted altitude compensation affects fueling, boost, and EGR. Sensor is inexpensive and easily replaced.

fixSteps.title: Compare to MAP at key-on
fixSteps.instruction: Both should read identical with engine off.

fixSteps.title: Replace BARO sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Two-bolt sensor on engine bay bracket.

faq.a: Sensor outputs change with altitude but P2227 is set on disagreement, not low value.
